ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: if the water level remains above 100 meters for more than 4 seconds.
missing_information: An upper limit to 'more than four consecutive seconds' or clarification on continuous vs. discrete time measurement.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text does not specify an exact duration beyond which the water level triggers a pump shutdown, nor is it clear whether this should be measured as cumulative elapsed time since last check (potentially allowing for multiple activations) versus strictly exceeding 4 consecutive seconds.
